description: This file defines the API for color filtering of subpixel bitmap glyphs in the FreeType library, including enumerations, function prototypes, and documentation for LCD filtering features.

methods.name: FT_Library_SetLcdFilter
methods.description: Sets the LCD filter type for color filtering of LCD-optimized bitmaps.

methods.name: FT_Library_SetLcdFilterWeights
methods.description: Overrides the default filter weights used for LCD filtering.
